products.title: HSW365 SCULPT — LED Neck & Jawline Device
products.description_html:
Your neck ages first. Most routines skip it.

SCULPT is a cordless at-home device for the neck, jawline and face. It uses three-color LED light, warm heat and micro-vibration together in one curved head that follows your jaw. Use it for a few minutes a day with your serum or cream.

Three lights, one device

  • Red: targets dullness and the look of fine lines.
  • Blue: for oily, congested skin and visible pores.
  • Green: calms skin that looks red or uneven.

Heat plus vibration

A steady 45°C warm compress paired with high-frequency micro-vibration. It helps your skincare absorb, eases tension in the neck and gives the jawline a firmer feel after each session.

8 modes, multiple intensity levels

Cleanse, infuse, lift and soothe. Aim it at neck lines, smile lines and under the chin.

Built for the curve

The ergonomic head sits flush along the neck and jaw, including the spots your hands miss. One button runs it, so there's nothing to learn.

The routine

  1. Apply your serum or neck cream.
  2. Pick a light and a mode.
  3. Glide upward from collarbone to jaw for a few minutes.

In the box

  • HSW365 SCULPT device
  • USB charging cable

For cosmetic use only. Not a medical device. Results vary by person. If you are pregnant, have a skin condition or light sensitivity, or use photosensitizing medication, ask your doctor before use.

HSW365. Turn Negative Into Positive.

products.title: THE MODERN DOG — The Positive-Training Blueprint (2026 Edition)
products.description_html:
Raise a calm, confident, obedient dog in 21 days — with humane, science-backed training. No yelling, no gadgets, no guesswork.

THE MODERN DOG is a premium 55-page illustrated digital guide that turns confusing dog behavior into a simple, repeatable system any owner can follow. Whether you just brought home a puppy, adopted a rescue, or you're finally fixing the habits of an older dog — this blueprint meets you where you are.

What's inside:

  • How dogs actually learn — and how to use it (reward-based / positive reinforcement)
  • Reading your dog's body language and moods
  • The core commands: name & focus, sit, down, stand, stay, recall, place, loose-leash walking
  • Life skills: crate training, potty training, socialization, problem behaviors
  • The complete 21-Day Blueprint — an exact day-by-day schedule
  • Troubleshooting FAQ + a Quick-Reference Cheat Sheet you can keep on your phone
  • Clear illustrations, hand-signal diagrams, and step-by-step visuals throughout

Just a few minutes a day. Built on kindness, consistency, and real behavioral science.

Format: Instant digital download (PDF). Read on any phone, tablet, or computer.

Published by HSW365 Media — Turn Negative Into Positive.

products.title: Cybersecurity for Everyone: A Practical, Simple Guide to Staying Safe in the Digital Age
products.description_html:
Cybersecurity doesn't have to be confusing, expensive, or reserved for IT pros.

Cybersecurity for Everyone is a plain-English, no-jargon guide to protecting the things that actually matter — your phone, computer, money, accounts, photos, business, and peace of mind.

Inside you'll learn how to:

  • Spot and shut down phishing before you click
  • Kill password reuse and lock down every important account
  • Set up two-factor authentication the right way
  • Secure your phone, computer, and social media
  • Protect your money from scams — including new AI-powered ones
  • Recover fast from a hack or account takeover
  • Build a realistic personal cybersecurity plan

Every chapter includes real-world scenarios, red flags, do-this / don't-do-this comparisons, Quick Checks, and immediate action steps — plus a 30-Day Cybersecurity Challenge and a quick-reference cheat sheet.

No scare tactics. No jargon parade. Just practical defenses you can start using today.

Instant digital download (PDF).

The story, printed so everyone can wear it. The Survivor Print Edition carries the exact artwork of Survivor Collection #002 "Gold Rush", the hand-bleached one-of-one by Army veteran and HSW365 founder Elvin Torres Sr., reproduced on a premium black cotton tee.

Every piece in the Survivor Collection traces one story: surviving the unspoken and wearing proof of it. Turn negative into positive.

  • Premium black cotton tee, printed to order
  • Artwork from the original hand-bleached #002
  • The signed one-of-one original lives in the Survivor Collection
